## Homework 5: The Big Bang Theory Transcript 

Show: The Big Bang Theory 
Episode: Season 1, Episode 1- Pliot 
Source: Fandom 

```{python}
with open("hw5_raw.txt", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    lines = file.readlines()
print(len(lines))
```

```{python}
clean_lines = []

for line in lines:
    cleaned = line.strip().lower()
    if cleaned != "":
        clean_lines.append(cleaned)

print(len(clean_lines))
```

```{python}
better_lines = []
for line in clean_lines:
    parts = line.split("*")
    dialogue = ""

    for i in range(len(parts)):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            dialogue = dialogue + parts[i]
    
    dialogue = dialogue.strip()

    if ":" in dialogue: 
        speaker, words = dialogue.split(":", 1)

        if words.strip() != "":
            better_lines.append(dialogue)

print(len(better_lines))
```


```{python}
final_lines = []

for line in better_lines:
    line = line.replace("howard (sings):", "howard:")
    final_lines.append(line)

print(len(final_lines))
```

```{python}
for line in final_lines[-10:]:
    print(line)
```

```{python}
dialogue_data = []

for line in final_lines:
    parts = line.split(":", 1)
    speaker = parts[0].strip()
    dialogue = parts[1].strip()
    dialogue_data.append({
        "speaker": speaker,
        "line": dialogue
    }) 

print(dialogue_data[:5])
```

```{python}
dialogue_data = [
    row for row in dialogue_data
    if row["speaker"].strip().lower() != "scene"
]

print(len(dialogue_data))
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd 
df = pd.DataFrame(dialogue_data)
df["line_number"] = range(1, len(df) + 1) 
print(df.head())
```

```{python}
df["character_length"] = df["line"].str.len()
df["word_count"] = df["line"].str.split().str.len()
df["is_sheldon"] = df["speaker"].str.lower() == "sheldon"
print(df.head()) 
```

```{python}
df.to_csv("hw5_pandas_mcneece_charlie.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print("CSV saved")
```

```{python}
check_df = pd.read_csv("hw5_pandas_mcneece_charlie.csv")

print(check_df.head(10))

print(len(check_df))
```

```{python}
    print(line)
```

## Closing Paragraph 
I used a transcript of an episode of The Big Bang Theory. Each row represents one line of dialogue and shows which character said it at the beginning of each line. I removed blank lines and scene descriptions, so it would only be the actual dialogue. I added columns to show the number of characters, number of words, and whether Sheldon was speaking. I noticed some lines were alot longer than others. My code reads the transcript, cleans it, puts it in a table, and I saved it as a CSV file. I used AI to troubleshoot my errors.
